question: At the same fixed student parameters, how do weighted hard CE and full or teacher-agreement-gated KL differ in gradient magnitude and direction?

hypotheses.initial_full_kl_larger_than_ce_majority: Of 48 initial-state probes, is the L2 norm of 2*KL gradient strictly larger than that of 0.5*CE in more than 24? This is an observed-probe description, not an independent-sample statistical test.
hypotheses.initial_gate_eliminates_negative_dot: All 48 initial-state weighted CE vs gated KL gradient dot products are nonnegative and both vectors nonzero. Any negative dot is a counterexample; zero-vector cases are undefined, not affirmative evidence.

hypothesis_basis: Previously saved training traces show more frequent total-gradient clipping under full/gated KD, but scalar loss shares and clipped total norms do not identify CE/KL parameter-gradient geometry.

selection.rule: Within each is_impossible stratum sort ascending SHA256 UTF-8 ce-kl-gradient-v1|ID and take first 8; concatenate answerable then unanswerable. No outcome filtering.
selection.primary: 48 initial-state paired probes at identical parameters
selection.secondary: 144 trained-endpoint probes; comparisons within each same checkpoint only; no across-checkpoint causal inference

training.optimizer: AdamW default betas and eps; weight_decay=0.01
training.gated_kd_objective: 0.5*CE + 0.5*T^2*sum(teacher argmax == gold ? token KL : 0)/N; N is ALL supervised positions
training.teacher_cache: Reuse the existing strictly bound teacher-gated-confirmation-v1 execution-02 cache; no cache regeneration or model conversion.

weights.gated_denominator: all supervised positions; do not renormalize by retained count

correctness.reference: Compare independent autograd gradients of the two combined objectives to weighted separate CE+KL gradients; compare analytic logit gradients respecting FP16 teacher probability mass; fail on nonfinite values, mismatch, source/hash mutation or parameter changes.

raw_array_policy.probe: First selected_id in each of 12 states, selected before model execution
raw_array_policy.parameter: Layer 0 self-attention q_proj lora_B weight only
raw_array_policy.contents: Five true parameter-gradient vectors (CE, full KL, gated KL, combined full, combined gated) plus identity; no model/adapter weights, teacher logits or private logs
raw_array_policy.remaining_probes: Full per-parameter Gram summaries and gradient digests; no claim that offline CI independently replays unarchived model autograd

scope.data: Only frozen 242-row TRAIN artifact/cache and 16 selected TRAIN questions. The previously consumed 256-question holdout is not read.
scope.training_configuration: training records how the existing checkpoints were trained; this diagnostic performs zero optimizer steps.

failure_policy: Own a fresh output directory before work; stop on correctness, identity, nonfinite or budget failure and save partial rows/status. Do not overwrite or retry completed output. Runtime/code repair requires a new execution version/protocol before retry.
interpretation: Gram/norm/cosine describe gradients at one fixed parameter state before clipping and before AdamW. They do not identify historical update trajectories or explain heldout quality causally.

Only 16 distinct TRAIN questions from 12 contexts are used; 192 probes are repeated parameter-state/seed observations, not independent samples. No sampling uncertainty or population generalization is estimated.
A zero vector yields null cosine and is counted separately. Positive logit agreement does not by itself guarantee parameter-gradient alignment.

Teacher FP16 log probabilities retain their recorded mass m=sum(q_teacher_cached). The unweighted KL derivative with respect to student logits is (m*p_student_T-q_teacher_cached)/T; weighted KL multiplies this by 2 and reduces across all N supervised positions.
LoRA A gradients can be zero at initialization because B starts at zero; this is expected, not numerical failure.
No candidate training, threshold selection or independent quality confirmation in this diagnosis.
The balanced 8+8 TRAIN selection is a diagnostic sample, not the 242-row class distribution or production traffic.

state_measurement.gradient_stage: before clipping and before any AdamW optimizer transform
state_measurement.ce_reference: 0.5 times CE component of the mixed objective, not gold-only training objective at weight 1.0
